title: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
content: USCIS warns applicants about businesses falsely promising faster visa and Green Card processing. These entities claim special government connections and demand fees for expedited services. Applicants should use official .gov resources and report suspicious offers to avoid unauthorized providers. The Department of Justice offers lists of low-cost or free legal immigration services. USCIS also provides tips for accurately completing and submitting application forms online.

title: 84-year-old veteran donated 207-acre llama ranch; now it is a sanctuary

With the Boulder Crest Foundation’s specialized initiatives, the campus is anticipated to be operational by September 2027, transforming lives one family at a time.

title: Michael Dell’s $10.9m Boston penthouse heads to auction with $6.5m reserve
content: Michael Dell's luxurious penthouse in Boston is hitting the auction block with a starting bid of $6.5 million. Initially acquired for $10.9 million a decade ago, this stunning property is situated on the 59th floor of the renowned Millennium Tower. Following several attempts at traditional sale routes, Dell has opted for an auction format that wraps up in late October, making it a must-watch event for high-end real estate enthusiasts.

title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
content: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.

title: Beyond 'Make in India': How India is trying to build a military it can truly call its own
content: India's defence establishment has spent the past year pushing an ambitious self-reliance agenda, shifting from "Make in India" toward "Owned by India." Key reforms include DAP 2026, domestic procurement allocation raised to 75%, new Buy Global-Manufacture in India and Make-III categories, and MSME-reserved acquisitions. The Defence Acquisition Council cleared 55 proposals worth Rs 6.73 lakh crore, including QRSAM, drone detection systems, AEW&C Mk-1A, Tejas Mk-1A and Rafale Marine. The Army restructured with Rudra All Arms Brigades, Bhairav commando battalions and Ashni drone platoons, responding to UAS gaps exposed during Operation Sindoor.

title: Flight fare analysis: Last-minute flight bookings cost 25% more on average
content: A ticket bought the day before departure costs about 25% more than the same journey booked 30 days ahead. On all 54 metro routes tracked, not one is cheaper to book late. The penalty runs from 3% on Bengaluru to Chennai to 121% on Ahmedabad to Pune. Thirty days out is the floor. Booking two or three months ahead is slightly dearer than booking one.

title: Naomi Osaka’s family faced eviction: How did she rise to Grand Slam glory?
content: During the evolution of her remarkable tennis career, which boasts four Grand Slam titles and a peak world ranking of number one, Naomi Osaka navigated challenging eviction notices. Beyond her athletic achievements, she has ventured into investments and sports ownership, notably launching successful skincare and media companies. Currently, she is ambitiously embracing luxury fashion projects, showcasing her versatility beyond the tennis court.

title: Travis Kelce’s $7.35M real estate portfolio: How did he build it?
content: Travis Kelce's real estate holdings include a $6 million Kansas City mansion, a $355,000 Florida condo co-owned with his family, and a former Kansas City home purchased for $995,000. Together, the three properties represent $7.35 million in purchase prices. While the mansion serves as his primary residence, the Florida condo reflects his family's ties to the Sunshine State.

title: Joe Thomas’ 4,100-acre farm: How did his cattle empire grow?
content: After hanging up his football jersey in 2018, former NFL star Joe Thomas took a new path in life as a cattle farmer in Wisconsin. His venture, Hall of Fame Farms, has flourished, now specializing in high-quality Wagyu and Certified Angus beef. With the same discipline that led him on the field, Thomas expertly navigates his agricultural journey, illustrating the power of perseverance in a completely different arena.

title: Veteran Bengali actress Mithu Mukherjee passes away in Mumbai at 71 - Report

She made her film debut in 1972 and rose to fame with Marjina Abdulla. She later appeared in Bengali and Hindi films alongside prominent actors before retiring from acting in the 1990s.

title: India reacts to new US tariffs law as Russian oil remains key to energy sourcing

content: he calls for an end to what he described as a "ridiculous and never-ending" war . he says several refineries have been damaged and are temporarily out of commission . "this ridiculous and never ending War with Ukraine must be ended," he adds .

title: CSK appoint Zaheer Khan as head coach after Stephen Fleming's exit
content: former pacer Zaheer Khan will take over as Chennai Super Kings' head coach . he played 92 Tests, 200 ODIs and 17 T20Is for the country . the 25-year-old was india's highest wicket-taker during their 2011 ODi world cup-winning campaign .

content: he slams the alleged harassment of a boy and a girl in jamui . he says the government seems to have lost all sense of shame or decency . "the rise in atrocities against women in Bihar is undeniable," he said .

title: Nandigram bypoll: Congress candidate sent to judicial custody till Oct 5 in 2007 case
content: Congress nominee Milan Pradhan was sent to judicial custody till October 5 . a contai court in west Bengal's Purba Medinipur district has remanded him . the order will be challenged before the Calcutta high court .

title: ‘I had no choice’: MMA fighter Varun Sanyal breaks silence after weight-cut blackout
content: MMA fighter Varun Sanyal was due to compete in the men's traditional 77kg event . the 27-year-old passed out on sunday while trying to make weight at his cruise-ship accommodation . he was declared medically unfit and could not compete .

title: IIT-B student suicide: Victim's father claims casteism; faculty march in support of prof
content: prof Suryanarayana Doolla was removed as dean amid protests over the death of student Sahil Wakode . the faculty forum said he had been relieved of his administrative duties to facilitate an independent investigation . doola has not been suspended from his service from IIT Bombay, the forum says .

title: Bihar harassment horror: Police arrest three, launch manhunt for four others
content: a video of the incident went viral on social media . three people have been arrested in connection with the alleged harassment of a minor boy and girl . a police officer has been formed to identify and arrest all those involved . the incident took place on the evening of September 19 .

title: ‘America has failed’: IRGC says war ‘not over’, warns of prolonged conflict with US
content: IRGC says the conflict with the united states and its allies is 'not over' he warns that Tehran is prepared for a prolonged confrontation if hostilities intensify in west Asia . he says any renewed escalation would trigger an Iranian response .

title: Bihar harassment case: NCW seeks immediate arrest of perpetrators
content: a video of the incident surfaced on social media . the incident reportedly took place on the evening of September 19 . police said the woman and the man were allegedly stopped and harassed by a group of people by the roadside .

title: 'We'll change geography of war': Iran warns US of new weapons, targets
content: IRGC warns that any fresh escalation with the united states could see Tehran deploy new weapons, adopt new military tactics and target locations that have not previously been struck . the islamic revolutionary guard said there would be "significant changes" in its defensive and counteroffensive operations if hostilities intensified .

title: Watch: Humanoid robot throws punches, kicks influencer across cage
content: a six-foot-tall humanoid robot faced an influencer in a fight in San Francisco . the event was organised as part of REK's work on a virtual reality combat game . a video shows the influencer facing the robot inside a cage .

title: Ram temple donations 'theft' case: SIT to file 1st chargesheet within 4 days
content: a four-member SIT is probing the alleged theft of donations at the Ram Temple in ayodhya . the statutory 90-day period from the first arrest in the case would lapse soon . an accused becomes entitled to statutory bail if the investigating agency fails to file a chargesheet in the trial court .

title: Asian Games swimming: R Madhavan's son misses final; Srihari Nataraj finishes 10th
content: Xu Jiayu of china competes in the men's 50m backstroke heats in swimming . two-time olympian finishes 10th in the women's final . the 25-year-old clocked 25.52 seconds in the final to finish last, slower than his 25.37-second effort .

title: US on alert after China's 'dual-use' research vessels spotted near Alaska
content: four Chinese research vessels have conducted work offshore in the US Arctic since the beginning of 2026 . the vessels do not notify their presence in advance as usual practice done through diplomatic channels, raising suspicion . "Where I have responsibility, interest and concern is when they are operating in and around US sovereign space," a commander says .
